name: Popup After Login
description: Shows a configurable SweetAlert2 popup to users after they log in — a one-time first-login message and/or an always-on message — targeted to selected roles, with the content returned from a JSON endpoint.
project_description:
Display pop-up message after user logged in. Provide configurable back-end to write message and shown in pop-up when user is logged in, Only once per login. 

 Provide Three types of pop-up messages 

1) Welcome pop-up after first time login.

2) Always show pop-up after logged in.

3) Use both, 'Pop-up after first time login' and then 'Always show pop-up after logged in'.

 Visibility 

1) You have to select role to show messages.

2) Pop-pup display option depends upon message title, If title is empty then pop-up message will not shown.

 Dependency 

This module depends upon sweetalert2 module , Because this will use sweetalert2 plug-in for pop-up functionality.

 Installation 

1) Download module and enable it.

2) Configure it by selecting Role which you want to show pop-up message and title , message for pop-up.

3) Clear cache and login with role that you selected.
